governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust.

candidates.intent: Load a PDF file and emit one document per page with text and page metadata.
candidates.input_contract: local file path or URL to a PDF document
candidates.output_contract: list of documents, one per page, each with page text and page-number metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot open a binary PDF file off disk and recover its page-level text and layout structure.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic byte-level PDF extraction (via pypdf) into clean per-page text documents the model can then reason over.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain is MIT-licensed; PyPDFLoader wraps the pypdf library; verified on LangChain reference docs. Scanned/complex-layout PDFs degrade accuracy.

candidates.intent: Load a PDF with layout-preserving extraction (columns, tables, reading order) into structured text.
candidates.input_contract: local file path to a PDF document plus optional mode (page/element)
candidates.output_contract: documents partitioned by layout element with element-type and coordinate metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model receives only raw flattened text and loses multi-column reading order and table boundaries in complex PDFs.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds layout-aware partitioning (Unstructured/pdfplumber/PyMuPDF) so columns, tables, and headings survive into the document structure.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; multiple PDF loaders exist in langchain_community.document_loaders (Unstructured, PDFPlumber, PyMuPDF, PDFMiner); some delegate to OCR/Unstructured which lowers determinism.

candidates.intent: Load a CSV file and emit one document per row with column values as content/metadata.
candidates.input_contract: local file path to a CSV plus optional source/column configuration
candidates.output_contract: list of documents, one per row, with formatted column content and row metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot read a CSV file from disk or deterministically map each row into a structured record.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic CSV parsing into per-row documents with column-aware metadata for downstream retrieval.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; CSVLoader uses Python csv module; fully deterministic parse. Verified on LangChain reference docs.

candidates.intent: Load an Excel/XLSX workbook and emit structured documents per sheet or row.
candidates.input_contract: local file path to an .xlsx/.xls workbook plus optional mode
candidates.output_contract: documents containing sheet/cell content with sheet-name and cell metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot open a binary Excel workbook or recover its multi-sheet tabular structure.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic workbook parsing (openpyxl/Unstructured) preserving sheets and cells as structured documents.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; UnstructuredExcelLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders; relies on Unstructured/openpyxl.

candidates.intent: Load a JSON or JSON Lines file and extract records into documents via a content/metadata schema.
candidates.input_contract: local file path to a JSON/JSONL file plus a jq-style content selector
candidates.output_contract: documents whose content/metadata are extracted at the configured JSON paths
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot stream a large JSON/JSONL file from disk and deterministically project fields into records.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic JSON parsing with a jq-schema selector to map nested fields into content and metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; JSONLoader uses jq schema; deterministic. Verified on LangChain reference docs.

candidates.intent: Fetch one or more web URLs and extract the visible text content as documents.
candidates.input_contract: one or more http(s) URLs plus optional parsing configuration
candidates.output_contract: documents containing extracted page text with source-URL metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot fetch a live web page or strip HTML chrome down to readable body text.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an HTTP fetch plus BeautifulSoup HTML-to-text extraction returning current page content with a source handle.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; WebBaseLoader uses requests + BeautifulSoup; content is live so not reproducible over time, but the parse step is deterministic.

candidates.intent: Recursively crawl a website from a root URL up to a depth and load all reachable pages.
candidates.input_contract: root URL plus max depth and optional link-extraction/exclusion rules
candidates.output_contract: documents for each crawled page with URL and depth metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot follow links across a site or assemble a multi-page corpus from a single seed URL.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds bounded recursive crawling that resolves and fetches reachable pages into a document set.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; RecursiveUrlLoader present in langchain_community; crawl frontier depends on live site state.

candidates.intent: Load all pages listed in a website's sitemap.xml into documents.
candidates.input_contract: sitemap URL plus optional URL filters
candidates.output_contract: documents for each sitemap entry with URL metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot parse a sitemap and enumerate every canonical page URL of a site.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic sitemap parsing plus batched fetching of the enumerated pages.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; SitemapLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders; sitemap parse deterministic, page content live.

candidates.intent: Load the transcript/captions of a YouTube video as a document.
candidates.input_contract: YouTube video URL or ID plus optional language and metadata flags
candidates.output_contract: document containing the timed transcript text with video metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot retrieve a specific video's caption track or read its spoken content.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic pull of the YouTube transcript API returning timed caption text with a video handle.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; YoutubeLoader uses youtube-transcript-api; verified on LangChain reference docs. Availability depends on captions existing.

candidates.intent: Load pages from a Notion database into documents using a Notion integration token.
candidates.input_contract: Notion integration token plus database ID
candidates.output_contract: documents for each Notion page with page properties as metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model has no access to a private Notion workspace's pages or their structured properties.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated Notion API reads converting database pages into documents with property metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; NotionDBLoader verified on LangChain reference docs; requires a Notion integration token; content is live.

candidates.intent: Load pages from an Atlassian Confluence space into documents.
candidates.input_contract: Confluence base URL, credentials/token, and space key or page IDs
candidates.output_contract: documents for each Confluence page with title/space metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot read a company's internal Confluence wiki pages behind authentication.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated Confluence REST reads converting wiki pages into documents with space metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; ConfluenceLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders; requires Confluence auth; content is live.

candidates.intent: Load a file or a directory of files from an Amazon S3 bucket into documents.
candidates.input_contract: S3 bucket name and key/prefix plus AWS credentials
candidates.output_contract: documents for each S3 object with bucket/key metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot authenticate to S3 or pull objects out of a private bucket.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds credentialed S3 retrieval (via boto3/Unstructured) turning bucket objects into parsed documents.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; S3FileLoader and S3DirectoryLoader verified on LangChain docs; uses boto3 + Unstructured for parsing.

candidates.intent: Load Google Docs/files from Google Drive into documents using OAuth credentials.
candidates.input_contract: Google OAuth credentials plus folder ID or document IDs
candidates.output_contract: documents for each Drive file with title/owner metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model has no access to a user's private Google Drive documents.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds OAuth Drive reads converting Docs/Sheets/PDFs in Drive into documents with file metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; GoogleDriveLoader verified on LangChain reference docs; requires Google OAuth; content is live.

candidates.intent: Walk a local directory, auto-select a reader per file extension, and load all matching files.
candidates.input_contract: directory path plus glob pattern and per-type loader configuration
candidates.output_contract: documents aggregated across all matched files with path metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot traverse a filesystem tree or dispatch the right parser per file type.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic directory traversal with glob filtering and per-extension loader dispatch.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; DirectoryLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders; traversal deterministic, per-file parse varies.

candidates.intent: Load a Microsoft Word .docx document into text documents.
candidates.input_contract: local file path to a .docx file plus optional mode
candidates.output_contract: documents containing the Word body text with paragraph/element metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot open a binary .docx archive or recover its formatted body text.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic Word extraction (docx2txt/Unstructured) producing clean body-text documents.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; Docx2txtLoader and UnstructuredWordDocumentLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders.

candidates.intent: Load a Microsoft PowerPoint .pptx deck into documents with slide text.
candidates.input_contract: local file path to a .pptx file plus optional mode
candidates.output_contract: documents containing slide text with slide-number metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot open a binary .pptx archive or recover slide text and notes.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic PowerPoint extraction (Unstructured/python-pptx) producing slide-level documents.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; UnstructuredPowerPointLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders; relies on Unstructured.

candidates.intent: Load an email message file (.eml/.msg) into a document with headers and body.
candidates.input_contract: local file path to an .eml or Outlook .msg file
candidates.output_contract: document with email body plus sender/recipient/subject metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot parse a raw RFC822/.msg email file into its headers and decoded body.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic email parsing extracting headers and body text into a document with sender/subject metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; UnstructuredEmailLoader and OutlookMessageLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders.

candidates.intent: Load a Markdown file into a document, optionally partitioned by Unstructured.
candidates.input_contract: local file path to a .md file plus optional mode
candidates.output_contract: documents containing Markdown content with element metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot read a Markdown file from disk or partition it into structural elements.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic Markdown loading with optional element partitioning into documents.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; UnstructuredMarkdownLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders.

candidates.intent: Load files or issues from a GitHub repository into documents.
candidates.input_contract: repository slug, branch/ref, and access token plus file/issue filters
candidates.output_contract: documents for each repo file or issue with path/number metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot enumerate the files or issues of a private GitHub repository at a given ref.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated GitHub API reads turning repo files and issues into documents with path/number metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; GitHubIssuesLoader and GithubFileLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders; requires token; content live.

candidates.intent: Clone or read a local Git repository and load its files as documents at a given branch.
candidates.input_contract: repo path or clone URL plus branch and file filter
candidates.output_contract: documents for each tracked file with path and branch metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot clone a Git repository or read its file tree at a specific commit/branch.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic Git checkout and file enumeration into documents carrying path and branch metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; GitLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders; uses GitPython; deterministic at a fixed commit.

candidates.intent: Load rows from a SQL database table/query into documents.
candidates.input_contract: database connection URI plus a SQL query or table name
candidates.output_contract: documents for query rows with column values as content/metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot connect to a SQL database or pull live rows from a table into context.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a parameterized SQL read (via SQLAlchemy) materializing rows into documents with column metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; SQLDatabaseLoader present in langchain_community.document_loaders; deterministic query, live data.

candidates.intent: Recursively read a local directory and auto-select the best LlamaIndex reader per file type.
candidates.input_contract: directory path or file list plus optional recursive/exclude flags
candidates.output_contract: list of LlamaIndex Document objects with file-path metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot walk a directory tree or pick the correct parser for each file extension.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic directory traversal with automatic per-extension reader selection into Document objects.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; SimpleDirectoryReader verified on LlamaIndex docs; traversal deterministic, per-file parse varies.

candidates.intent: Parse common file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, CSV, EPUB, images) into LlamaIndex documents.
candidates.input_contract: local file path of a supported format
candidates.output_contract: Document objects with extracted text and file metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot open binary office/document formats off disk and recover their text.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a bundle of deterministic per-format readers producing normalized Document objects.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; llama-index-readers-file verified on LlamaHub/PyPI; bundles PDFReader, DocxReader, PptxReader, CSVReader, etc.

candidates.intent: Read rows from a SQL database into LlamaIndex documents via a query.
candidates.input_contract: SQLAlchemy connection plus a SQL query
candidates.output_contract: Document objects for query rows with column metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot connect to a relational database or pull live query results into context.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a parameterized SQL read materializing rows into LlamaIndex Document objects.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; DatabaseReader is a documented LlamaHub connector; deterministic query, live data.

candidates.intent: Load Notion pages/databases into LlamaIndex documents using an integration token.
candidates.input_contract: Notion integration token plus page or database IDs
candidates.output_contract: Document objects for Notion pages with property metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model has no access to a private Notion workspace's pages.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated Notion reads converting pages into LlamaIndex documents with metadata.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; NotionPageReader is a documented LlamaHub connector; requires Notion token; content live.

candidates.intent: Load messages from Slack channels into LlamaIndex documents using a bot token.
candidates.input_contract: Slack bot token plus channel IDs and optional time range
candidates.output_contract: Document objects for channel messages with channel/timestamp metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot read a workspace's Slack channel history behind authentication.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated Slack API reads turning channel messages into LlamaIndex documents.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; SlackReader is a documented LlamaHub connector; requires Slack bot token; content live.

candidates.intent: Split text into overlapping chunks by recursively trying paragraph, sentence, then word boundaries.
candidates.input_contract: text or documents plus chunk size, overlap, and separator list
candidates.output_contract: list of chunk documents with preserved source metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model has a fixed context window and no built-in way to chunk a long document on natural boundaries.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic recursive splitter that keeps paragraphs/sentences intact while bounding chunk size with overlap.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter verified on LangChain splitters docs; pure string algorithm, fully deterministic.

candidates.intent: Split text into fixed-size chunks on a single separator with overlap.
candidates.input_contract: text plus chunk size, overlap, and separator
candidates.output_contract: list of chunk documents with source metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot deterministically segment text by character count on a chosen delimiter.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a simple deterministic length-based splitter on a single separator.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; CharacterTextSplitter verified on LangChain splitters docs; deterministic.

candidates.intent: Split text into chunks bounded by token count using a tokenizer.
candidates.input_contract: text plus chunk size and overlap measured in tokens, and an encoding name
candidates.output_contract: list of chunk documents sized to a token budget
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model needs chunks aligned to its tokenizer to avoid exceeding context limits, which raw character splitting does not guarantee.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds token-aware chunking (via tiktoken) so each chunk fits a precise token budget.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; TokenTextSplitter uses tiktoken; deterministic given a fixed encoding. Verified on LangChain docs.

candidates.intent: Split a Markdown document on header levels, attaching header hierarchy as metadata.
candidates.input_contract: Markdown text plus a list of header levels to split on
candidates.output_contract: chunk documents tagged with their header path metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot segment Markdown along its semantic header structure or preserve section provenance.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic header-aware splitter that tags each chunk with its H1/H2/H3 path for structured retrieval.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter verified on LangChain splitters docs; deterministic header parse.

candidates.intent: Split an HTML document on heading/section tags, attaching the heading hierarchy as metadata.
candidates.input_contract: HTML text plus header tags to split on
candidates.output_contract: chunk documents tagged with their heading-path metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot segment HTML along its DOM heading structure or preserve section provenance.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic HTML header/section splitting that tags chunks with their heading path.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; HTMLHeaderTextSplitter and HTMLSectionSplitter present in langchain-text-splitters; deterministic DOM parse.

candidates.intent: Split a large JSON object into chunks along object and array boundaries within a size budget.
candidates.input_contract: JSON object plus max chunk size
candidates.output_contract: list of JSON-chunk documents that stay valid JSON fragments
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot chunk a large nested JSON document while keeping fragments structurally valid.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic recursive JSON chunking that splits on object/array boundaries under a size cap.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; RecursiveJsonSplitter verified on LangChain splitters docs; deterministic structural split.

candidates.intent: Split source code into chunks on language-specific syntactic boundaries (functions, classes).
candidates.input_contract: source code text plus a language identifier and chunk size
candidates.output_contract: chunk documents aligned to code structure for the chosen language
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model chunking code by raw characters cuts through functions and breaks syntactic units.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds language-aware separator sets so chunks align to code constructs across many languages.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; from_language supports Python, JS, Markdown, etc.; deterministic. Verified on LangChain splitters docs.

candidates.intent: Split text at semantic boundaries detected from embedding-similarity drops between sentences.
candidates.input_contract: text plus an embeddings model and a breakpoint threshold
candidates.output_contract: chunk documents grouped by semantic cohesion
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Fixed-size chunking splits mid-topic; a bare model cannot decide chunk boundaries from meaning.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds embedding-similarity breakpoint detection so chunks contain semantically related sentences.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; SemanticChunker lives in langchain_experimental; depends on an embeddings model so determinism is bounded by it.

candidates.intent: Split documents into chunks that try to keep complete sentences within a size and overlap.
candidates.input_contract: documents plus chunk size and overlap
candidates.output_contract: TextNode objects sized to the budget with source relationships
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot chunk documents while keeping sentence boundaries intact within a token budget.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic sentence-preserving chunker emitting TextNodes with source links.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; SentenceSplitter exported from llama_index.core.node_parser (verified in GitHub __init__); deterministic.

candidates.intent: Create one node per sentence and store a surrounding-sentence window in metadata for context replacement.
candidates.input_contract: documents plus window size
candidates.output_contract: per-sentence nodes carrying a context window in metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot build tightly-scoped embedding units while retaining a recoverable wider context.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds per-sentence nodes with a stored window so retrieval embeds narrowly but can rehydrate surrounding context.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; SentenceWindowNodeParser exported from llama_index.core.node_parser (verified in GitHub __init__); deterministic.

candidates.intent: Adaptively pick chunk breakpoints between sentences using embedding similarity.
candidates.input_contract: documents plus an embeddings model and breakpoint percentile
candidates.output_contract: semantically cohesive nodes with source relationships
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Fixed-size chunking splits mid-topic; a bare model cannot place breakpoints from semantic similarity.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds embedding-similarity breakpoint selection so each node groups related sentences.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; SemanticSplitterNodeParser exported from llama_index.core.node_parser (verified in GitHub __init__); embedding-dependent.

candidates.intent: Produce a multi-level hierarchy of parent/child nodes at several chunk sizes for auto-merging retrieval.
candidates.input_contract: documents plus a list of chunk sizes
candidates.output_contract: nodes at multiple granularities linked by parent/child relationships
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot build a coarse-to-fine node tree to support auto-merging retrieval of larger contexts.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic multi-size chunking with linked parent/child nodes enabling auto-merge retrieval.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; HierarchicalNodeParser exported from llama_index.core.node_parser (verified in GitHub __init__); deterministic.

candidates.intent: Parse Markdown into nodes split by header structure with header-path metadata.
candidates.input_contract: Markdown documents
candidates.output_contract: nodes per Markdown section with header metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot split Markdown along its header hierarchy or attach section provenance to chunks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic Markdown sectioning into nodes tagged with their header path.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; MarkdownNodeParser exported from llama_index.core.node_parser (verified in GitHub __init__); deterministic.

candidates.intent: Split source code into nodes using a language-aware (tree-sitter) parser.
candidates.input_contract: code documents plus language, chunk lines, and overlap
candidates.output_contract: code-structure-aligned nodes with source relationships
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model chunking code by lines cuts through functions and loses syntactic structure.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds tree-sitter-based code chunking so nodes align to language constructs.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; CodeSplitter exported from llama_index.core.node_parser (verified in GitHub __init__); uses tree-sitter; deterministic.

candidates.intent: Retrieve documents by sparse keyword relevance using the BM25 ranking function.
candidates.input_contract: a query string over a corpus of documents plus top-k
candidates.output_contract: top-k documents ranked by BM25 score
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A dense-embedding-only model misses exact rare terms, IDs, and codes that keyword search reliably finds.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic BM25 sparse retriever that surfaces exact-term matches embeddings overlook.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; BM25Retriever present in langchain_community.retrievers (uses rank_bm25); deterministic ranking given a fixed corpus.

candidates.intent: Embed small child chunks for precision but return their larger parent documents for context.
candidates.input_contract: a query plus a vector store of child chunks and a docstore of parents
candidates.output_contract: parent documents whose child chunks matched the query
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Small chunks retrieve precisely but starve the model of context; large chunks dilute relevance.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds child-chunk matching with parent-document return, giving both precision and full context.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; ParentDocumentRetriever is a documented LangChain retriever; ranking depends on the underlying embeddings.

candidates.intent: Translate a natural-language query into a vector search plus structured metadata filters automatically.
candidates.input_contract: a natural-language query, an LLM, and a metadata-field schema
candidates.output_contract: documents matching both the semantic query and the inferred metadata filters
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare similarity search ignores structured constraints like dates or categories embedded in a question.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds LLM-driven query decomposition into a vector query plus metadata filters for constrained retrieval.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; SelfQueryRetriever is documented; uses an LLM to build filters so the filter step is non-deterministic.

candidates.intent: Generate several query rephrasings with an LLM, retrieve for each, and union the deduplicated results.
candidates.input_contract: a query, an LLM, and a base retriever
candidates.output_contract: deduplicated union of documents across generated query variants
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A single phrasing of a query misses relevant documents indexed under different wording.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds automatic query expansion and result fusion to improve recall over a single query.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; MultiQueryRetriever is documented; query generation uses an LLM so it is non-deterministic.

candidates.intent: Post-process retrieved documents to extract or filter only the query-relevant content before returning.
candidates.input_contract: a query, a base retriever, and a document compressor
candidates.output_contract: compressed/filtered documents containing only relevant passages
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Raw retrieved chunks include irrelevant text that wastes context and dilutes the answer signal.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a compression/extraction pass so only query-relevant passages reach the model.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; ContextualCompressionRetriever is documented; determinism depends on the compressor (LLM-based vs embeddings-filter).

candidates.intent: Combine multiple retrievers (e.g. BM25 + dense) and fuse their rankings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
candidates.input_contract: a query plus a list of retrievers and fusion weights
candidates.output_contract: a single re-ranked document list fusing all retrievers
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Either sparse or dense retrieval alone misses cases the other catches; a bare model cannot fuse them.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Reciprocal Rank Fusion over multiple retrievers for results that are both semantic and keyword-accurate.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; EnsembleRetriever uses RRF; fusion is deterministic but inherits any non-determinism of member retrievers.

candidates.intent: Retrieve documents combining semantic similarity with a time-decay weighting toward recent items.
candidates.input_contract: a query plus a vector store with timestamps and a decay rate
candidates.output_contract: documents scored by similarity blended with recency
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Pure similarity ignores recency, surfacing stale memories over fresh ones in agent/memory use.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a recency-aware decay term to similarity scoring so recent items are favored.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; TimeWeightedVectorStoreRetriever is documented; decay math deterministic given fixed timestamps.

candidates.intent: Store embeddings and run similarity/metadata-filtered search using the Chroma vector database.
candidates.input_contract: documents/embeddings to index, or a query vector plus top-k and filters
candidates.output_contract: indexed collection or top-k nearest documents with scores
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model has no persistent index to do nearest-neighbor lookup over a private corpus.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an embedded vector index (Chroma) with metadata-filtered similarity search the model can query.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; Chroma integration is officially supported; ANN search is deterministic given a fixed index/params.

candidates.intent: Store embeddings and run fast in-memory/local similarity search using FAISS.
candidates.input_contract: embeddings to index, or a query vector plus top-k
candidates.output_contract: top-k nearest vectors with distances
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot do local nearest-neighbor search over millions of vectors without an index.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a fast FAISS index for local similarity search with no external service dependency.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; FAISS integration is officially supported; exact/IVF search deterministic given fixed index params (FAISS is itself MIT).

candidates.intent: Store embeddings in Postgres and run similarity search via the pgvector extension.
candidates.input_contract: Postgres connection plus documents/embeddings, or a query vector and filters
candidates.output_contract: top-k nearest documents from a SQL-backed index
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot run vector search co-located with relational data in Postgres.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds pgvector-backed similarity search so embeddings live next to transactional rows with SQL filters.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; PGVector integration officially supported; search deterministic given fixed index/operator class.

candidates.intent: Store and query embeddings using the managed Pinecone vector database service.
candidates.input_contract: Pinecone API key/index plus documents/embeddings, or a query vector and filters
candidates.output_contract: top-k nearest documents with scores from the managed index
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot perform scalable hosted nearest-neighbor search over a managed index.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds managed, scalable Pinecone similarity search with metadata filtering callable from the pipeline.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; Pinecone integration officially supported; results deterministic per index version but service-hosted.

candidates.intent: Store and query embeddings using the Weaviate vector database, including hybrid search.
candidates.input_contract: Weaviate endpoint plus objects/embeddings, or a query and hybrid-search params
candidates.output_contract: top-k nearest objects with scores and optional hybrid ranking
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot run combined vector + keyword (hybrid) search over a private object store.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Weaviate similarity and hybrid search with schema-typed objects callable from the pipeline.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; Weaviate integration officially supported; deterministic per index config (Weaviate is BSD-3).

candidates.intent: Store and query embeddings using the Qdrant vector database with rich payload filtering.
candidates.input_contract: Qdrant endpoint plus points/embeddings, or a query vector and payload filters
candidates.output_contract: top-k nearest points with scores and payloads
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot run filtered nearest-neighbor search with structured payload conditions.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Qdrant similarity search with expressive payload filtering callable from the pipeline.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; Qdrant integration officially supported; deterministic per index/HNSW params (Qdrant is Apache-2.0).

candidates.intent: Store and query embeddings at scale using the Milvus vector database.
candidates.input_contract: Milvus connection plus entities/embeddings, or a query vector and filters
candidates.output_contract: top-k nearest entities with distances
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot run billion-scale nearest-neighbor search over a distributed index.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Milvus distributed similarity search for very large vector corpora callable from the pipeline.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; Milvus integration officially supported; deterministic per index config (Milvus is Apache-2.0).

candidates.intent: Store and query embeddings using Redis with vector similarity search.
candidates.input_contract: Redis connection plus documents/embeddings, or a query vector and filters
candidates.output_contract: top-k nearest documents with scores from the Redis index
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot co-locate low-latency vector search with a cache/key-value store.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Redis vector similarity search with sub-ms latency callable from the pipeline.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; Redis integration officially supported; deterministic per index schema.

candidates.intent: Store and query embeddings using OpenSearch/Elasticsearch with kNN and hybrid search.
candidates.input_contract: OpenSearch endpoint plus documents/embeddings, or a query and kNN/hybrid params
candidates.output_contract: top-k nearest documents with scores and optional BM25 hybrid ranking
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot combine full-text and vector search over an enterprise search cluster.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds OpenSearch/Elasticsearch kNN plus BM25 hybrid retrieval callable from the pipeline.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; OpenSearch and Elasticsearch vector stores officially supported; deterministic per index config.

candidates.intent: Generate dense text embeddings via the OpenAI embeddings API.
candidates.input_contract: text or list of texts plus a model name and API key
candidates.output_contract: fixed-dimension embedding vectors per input text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare generation model does not itself expose a stable embedding vector for similarity/retrieval.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a uniform embeddings interface to OpenAI models producing vectors for indexing and search.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; OpenAIEmbeddings verified on LangChain embeddings docs; vectors near-deterministic for a fixed model snapshot.

candidates.intent: Generate dense embeddings locally using sentence-transformers / Hugging Face models.
candidates.input_contract: text or list of texts plus a local/HF model name
candidates.output_contract: fixed-dimension embedding vectors per input text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot run a local embedding model offline to produce private, no-egress vectors.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds local sentence-transformers embedding so vectors are produced on-prem without an API call.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; HuggingFaceEmbeddings wraps sentence_transformers; deterministic on fixed weights/hardware. Verified on LangChain docs.

candidates.intent: Generate dense text embeddings via the Cohere embeddings API, including input-type modes.
candidates.input_contract: text or list of texts plus a model name, input type, and API key
candidates.output_contract: fixed-dimension embedding vectors per input text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model does not expose Cohere's query/document-typed embedding vectors for retrieval.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a uniform interface to Cohere embeddings with search-optimized input-type handling.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; CohereEmbeddings verified on LangChain embeddings docs; vectors stable per model version.

candidates.intent: Generate embeddings from locally-served models via an Ollama runtime.
candidates.input_contract: text plus a local Ollama model name and host
candidates.output_contract: embedding vectors per input text from the local model
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot embed text privately through a local model server with no external egress.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an embeddings interface to a local Ollama runtime for private offline vectorization.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; OllamaEmbeddings verified on LangChain embeddings docs; deterministic per local model build.

candidates.intent: Generate retrieval-optimized dense embeddings via the Voyage AI API.
candidates.input_contract: text or list of texts plus a model name and API key
candidates.output_contract: fixed-dimension embedding vectors per input text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model does not expose Voyage's retrieval-tuned embedding vectors for high-quality search.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a uniform interface to Voyage AI embeddings tuned for retrieval quality.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; VoyageAIEmbeddings verified on LangChain embeddings docs; vectors stable per model version.

candidates.intent: Generate embeddings locally and quickly using quantized ONNX models via FastEmbed.
candidates.input_contract: text or list of texts plus a supported FastEmbed model name
candidates.output_contract: fixed-dimension embedding vectors per input text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot run lightweight CPU-friendly local embedding without heavy dependencies.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds fast ONNX-quantized local embeddings (FastEmbed/Qdrant) for cheap CPU vectorization.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; FastEmbedEmbeddings present in langchain_community.embeddings; wraps Qdrant FastEmbed (Apache-2.0); deterministic on fixed model.

candidates.intent: Parse and validate an LLM's text output into a typed Pydantic model, with format instructions.
candidates.input_contract: an LLM completion string plus a target Pydantic model
candidates.output_contract: a validated instance of the Pydantic model, or a parse error
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Raw LLM text is unvalidated and may violate a required schema or types downstream code needs.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic JSON-to-Pydantic parsing with type validation, converting free text into a checked object.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; PydanticOutputParser is core; the parse+validate step is deterministic (the upstream generation is not).

candidates.intent: Parse an LLM's output into a flat dict matching a declared set of named string fields.
candidates.input_contract: an LLM completion string plus a list of ResponseSchema field specs
candidates.output_contract: a dict keyed by the declared field names
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Free-form model text has no guaranteed key/value structure for programmatic consumption.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a lightweight schema-to-dict parser with generated format instructions for simple structured extraction.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; StructuredOutputParser is core; parse step deterministic, no type validation (unlike Pydantic).

candidates.intent: Parse (and stream partial) JSON objects out of an LLM's textual output.
candidates.input_contract: an LLM completion string or token stream plus an optional schema
candidates.output_contract: a parsed JSON/dict object, including incremental partials when streaming
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model emits JSON inside prose; downstream code needs a robust parser tolerant of partial streams.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a tolerant JSON extractor that recovers a valid object and supports incremental streaming parses.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; JsonOutputParser is core and streams partial JSON; parse step deterministic. Verified on output-parser references.

candidates.intent: Parse an LLM's output into a Python list from a comma-separated string.
candidates.input_contract: an LLM completion string of comma-separated items
candidates.output_contract: a list of trimmed string items
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model returns a list as prose; code needs a clean array, not a sentence.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic comma-split parser with format instructions yielding a clean list.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; CommaSeparatedListOutputParser is core; deterministic split. Verified on output-parser references.

candidates.intent: Parse an LLM's output into a Python datetime using a specified format.
candidates.input_contract: an LLM completion string plus a datetime format pattern
candidates.output_contract: a parsed datetime object, or a parse error
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Date strings from a model vary in format; code needs a normalized datetime value.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic strptime-based parser converting model text into a typed datetime.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; DatetimeOutputParser is core; deterministic format parse. Verified on output-parser references.

candidates.intent: Constrain and parse an LLM's output to a member of a fixed enumeration.
candidates.input_contract: an LLM completion string plus a Python Enum class
candidates.output_contract: a validated enum member, or a parse error
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model may emit an out-of-set label; code needs the value clamped to a known enumeration.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic validation of model output against an enum, rejecting out-of-set values.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; EnumOutputParser is core; deterministic membership check. Verified on output-parser references.

candidates.intent: Parse an LLM's output into a nested dict/tree from XML, with format instructions.
candidates.input_contract: an LLM completion string containing XML plus optional allowed tags
candidates.output_contract: a parsed nested structure from the XML tree
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model emits XML inside prose; downstream code needs a parsed tree, not raw markup.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic XML extractor and tree parser with tag-format instructions.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; XMLOutputParser is core; parse step deterministic. Verified on output-parser references.

candidates.intent: Wrap another parser and, on failure, use an LLM to repair malformed output and re-parse.
candidates.input_contract: a malformed LLM output, a base parser, and an LLM
candidates.output_contract: the successfully re-parsed object after a repair pass
candidates.gap_hypothesis: When a model's structured output fails validation, a bare pipeline simply errors out with no recovery.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an automatic LLM-driven repair-and-retry layer that recovers from parse failures.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; OutputFixingParser is documented; the repair step invokes an LLM, so it is non-deterministic.

candidates.intent: Drop near-duplicate documents by comparing their embeddings against a similarity threshold.
candidates.input_contract: a set of documents plus an embeddings model and similarity threshold
candidates.output_contract: the document set with redundant near-duplicates removed
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Retrieved sets often contain redundant chunks that waste context; a bare model cannot dedupe by meaning.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds embedding-similarity dedup that removes near-duplicate documents before they reach the model.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; EmbeddingsRedundantFilter verified on LangChain reference docs; thresholded cosine dedup, deterministic given fixed embeddings.

candidates.intent: Cluster documents by embedding (k-means) and keep the items closest to each cluster center.
candidates.input_contract: a set of documents plus an embeddings model and number of clusters
candidates.output_contract: a representative subset of documents nearest the cluster centers
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A large retrieved set needs a diverse representative subset; a bare model cannot cluster by meaning.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds k-means clustering over embeddings to pick a diverse, representative document subset.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; EmbeddingsClusteringFilter verified on LangChain reference docs; k-means is deterministic given fixed seed/embeddings.

candidates.intent: Reorder retrieved documents so the most relevant sit at the start and end, mitigating lost-in-the-middle.
candidates.input_contract: an ordered list of relevance-ranked documents
candidates.output_contract: the same documents reordered to place top items at the extremes
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models attend worst to content in the middle of long contexts, hurting answers from mid-list documents.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic reordering that places the most relevant chunks where attention is strongest.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; LongContextReorder verified on LangChain reference docs; pure reordering algorithm, fully deterministic.

candidates.intent: Convert HTML document content into clean plain-text/Markdown for downstream chunking.
candidates.input_contract: documents containing HTML content
candidates.output_contract: documents with HTML stripped to plain text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Raw HTML carries tags and chrome that pollute the text a model sees.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic HTML-to-text conversion producing clean readable content.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; Html2TextTransformer verified on LangChain reference docs; wraps html2text; deterministic.

candidates.intent: Extract specified HTML tags and strip unwanted ones from document content.
candidates.input_contract: documents with HTML content plus tags to keep/remove
candidates.output_contract: documents containing only the selected tag content
candidates.gap_hypothesis:
A bare model cannot selectively keep meaningful HTML tags (e.g.

,

  • ) and discard nav/script.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic tag-level extraction/cleaning so only meaningful HTML content survives.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; BeautifulSoupTransformer verified on LangChain reference docs; deterministic tag filtering.

candidates.intent: Re-rank retrieved nodes with a cross-encoder and keep the top-N most relevant.
candidates.input_contract: a query plus retrieved nodes, a cross-encoder model, and top-n
candidates.output_contract: the top-n nodes re-ordered by cross-encoder relevance
candidates.gap_hypothesis: First-stage vector recall ranks coarsely; a bare model cannot apply a precise relevance re-scoring.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a local cross-encoder re-ranking stage that sharpens precision of the top results.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; SentenceTransformerRerank is a documented core postprocessor; deterministic on fixed cross-encoder weights.

candidates.intent: Re-rank retrieved nodes using the Cohere Rerank API and keep the top-N.
candidates.input_contract: a query plus retrieved nodes, a Cohere API key, and top-n
candidates.output_contract: the top-n nodes re-ordered by Cohere relevance scores
candidates.gap_hypothesis: First-stage recall ranks coarsely; a bare model cannot call a hosted reranker to re-score relevance.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a managed Cohere Rerank stage that improves precision of the retrieved top set.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; CohereRerank is a documented postprocessor package; scores stable per model version, service-hosted.

candidates.intent: Re-rank retrieved nodes by asking an LLM to score each node's relevance to the query.
candidates.input_contract: a query plus retrieved nodes, an LLM, and top-n
candidates.output_contract: the top-n nodes re-ordered by LLM-assigned relevance
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Vector scores miss nuanced relevance; without an explicit scoring pass results stay coarsely ranked.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an LLM relevance-scoring re-rank for nuanced reordering of the retrieved set.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; LLMRerank verified on LlamaIndex postprocessor docs; scoring uses an LLM so it is non-deterministic.

candidates.intent: Filter retrieved nodes by dropping those below a similarity-score cutoff.
candidates.input_contract: retrieved nodes with scores plus a similarity cutoff
candidates.output_contract: only the nodes meeting or exceeding the cutoff
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Top-k recall can include low-relevance nodes; a bare model cannot threshold them out by score.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic score-cutoff filter removing weak matches before generation.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; SimilarityPostprocessor is a documented core postprocessor; pure threshold, fully deterministic.

candidates.intent: Reorder retrieved nodes to place the most relevant at the start and end to mitigate lost-in-the-middle.
candidates.input_contract: an ordered list of relevance-ranked nodes
candidates.output_contract: the nodes reordered to place top items at the extremes
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models attend worst to the middle of long contexts, hurting answers drawn from mid-list nodes.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic reordering placing the strongest nodes where model attention is highest.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; LongContextReorder is a documented core postprocessor; pure reordering, fully deterministic.

candidates.intent: Replace a node's text with a stored metadata field (e.g. its surrounding-sentence window) at query time.
candidates.input_contract: retrieved nodes carrying a target metadata key
candidates.output_contract: nodes whose content is swapped for the metadata window
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Sentence-window indexing embeds narrowly, but the model still needs the surrounding context at answer time.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic swap of narrow node text for its stored wider window before generation.
candidates.verify_note: LlamaIndex MIT; MetadataReplacementPostProcessor is a documented core postprocessor; deterministic field swap; pairs with SentenceWindowNodeParser.

candidates.intent: Store and replay the full verbatim conversation history into each LLM call.
candidates.input_contract: the running sequence of user/AI messages
candidates.output_contract: the full message history formatted for prompt insertion
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A stateless model forgets prior turns; without explicit memory each call has no conversational context.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic full-history buffering and re-injection so the model sees the whole dialogue.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; ConversationBufferMemory verified on memory references; pure store/replay, deterministic.

candidates.intent: Keep only the last k conversation turns and replay that sliding window.
candidates.input_contract: the message sequence plus a window size k
candidates.output_contract: the most recent k turns formatted for prompt insertion
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Full-history replay overflows the context window on long chats; a bare model cannot bound what it remembers.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic sliding-window buffer keeping recent turns within a fixed budget.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; ConversationBufferWindowMemory verified on memory references; deterministic windowing.

candidates.intent: Maintain a running LLM-generated summary of the conversation instead of the full transcript.
candidates.input_contract: the message sequence plus an LLM for summarization
candidates.output_contract: a condensed summary string of the dialogue so far
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Long dialogues exceed context limits; verbatim replay is wasteful and a bare model cannot self-summarize state.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds incremental LLM summarization that compresses history while preserving key context.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; ConversationSummaryMemory verified on memory references; the summarization step uses an LLM, so non-deterministic.

candidates.intent: Keep recent turns verbatim up to a token budget and summarize older turns into a rolling summary.
candidates.input_contract: the message sequence, an LLM, and a max token limit
candidates.output_contract: a summary of old turns plus recent verbatim turns
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Pure summary loses recent detail; pure buffer overflows; a bare model cannot balance the two.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a hybrid that preserves recent detail verbatim while summarizing older context under a budget.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; ConversationSummaryBufferMemory verified on memory references; summarization step uses an LLM, so non-deterministic.

candidates.intent: Persist conversation snippets in a vector store and retrieve the most relevant past context per query.
candidates.input_contract: a query plus a vector store of stored memory snippets
candidates.output_contract: the most relevant retrieved memory snippets for the current turn
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Replaying all history is wasteful; a bare model cannot recall only the relevant slice of long-term memory.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds semantic retrieval over stored memories so only contextually relevant snippets are injected.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; VectorStoreRetrieverMemory verified on memory references; retrieval determinism bounded by the embeddings/index.

candidates.intent: Extract and maintain a key-value store of entities (people, places, things) mentioned in the dialogue.
candidates.input_contract: the message sequence plus an LLM for entity extraction
candidates.output_contract: a per-entity summary store retrievable by entity name
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model loses track of facts about specific entities across a long conversation.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds LLM-driven entity extraction into a structured store so per-entity facts persist and can be recalled.
candidates.verify_note: LangChain MIT; ConversationEntityMemory verified on memory references; entity extraction uses an LLM, so non-deterministic.
